description: Angular component for health check dashboard, displaying system status, database status, uptime, and handling periodic refreshes.

classes.name: HealthComponent
classes.description: Angular component managing health status display and refresh logic.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets up auto-refresh timer, and performs initial health fetch.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscription on component destruction.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Manually triggers a health status refresh.

methods.name: applyResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a health check and updates component state.

methods.name: formatDurationSeconds
methods.description: Formats uptime seconds into a human-readable string.
